scope: public primary metadata/abstracts, no numerical assay data

queries.temporal_state_function: FIRST_PDATE:[2025-01-01 TO 2026-10-22] AND ("single cell" OR "single-cell") AND drug AND ("time-resolved" OR longitudinal) AND (viability OR proliferation OR survival)
queries.live_state_therapy: FIRST_PDATE:[2025-01-01 TO 2026-10-22] AND ("live-cell" OR "live cell") AND ("drug response" OR "drug resistance") AND (trajectory OR trajectories OR lineage)
queries.interventional_dynamics: FIRST_PDATE:[2025-01-01 TO 2026-10-22] AND ("cell dynamics" OR "cellular dynamics") AND ("world model" OR "system identification" OR "perturbation prediction")

selection: Inspect real observation timing, independent units, paired functional endpoints; no novel algorithm assumed
